authority: User approved decision-value retention and disposal after rejecting reference-only preservation; CR-1 remains unstarted.
scope: All 25,755 logical entries of the historical consolidation inventory, plus its physical ZIP and four subsequent gzip storage files.

current-candidate-captures.use: Current seven reviewed sample4 candidate contexts, all 160 candidate bindings and qualified Foam/texture opposition.
current-candidate-captures.loss: Exact frozen candidate features and source/working geometry would require an unnecessary detector replay.
current-candidate-captures.minimality: 45 inputs (29 A1 and 16 Local XY rasters), not the full Local XY experiment.
current-candidate-captures.review_when: After the successor input contract has bound or replaced these captures.

qualified-control-rasters.use: Preserve all 42 frozen S2 raster views as the existing positive/opposition candidate and geometry basis.
qualified-control-rasters.loss: Pinned source crops, masks and graph/candidate bindings would be lost; decoded reproduction can drift.
qualified-control-rasters.minimality: 112 raster/graph files; retire the whole FULL trace, derived scores and duplicate run bundles. This does not promise full historical S2 rerun.
qualified-control-rasters.review_when: At successor input selection; replace redundant derived arrays when exact transforms and required evidence suffice.

qualified-source-pixels.use: Inspect source-qualified water/beer/milk scenes and reviewed neighbor context before any new comparison.
qualified-source-pixels.loss: Exact reviewed native pixels and their relation to regions/cropped visibility.
qualified-source-pixels.minimality: 16 selected native frames, not every intake frame, temporal stack or copied contact sheet.
qualified-source-pixels.review_when: When successor source/capture pins replace the current scene basis.

quarantined-review-evidence.use: Preserve the A/B regional, C structural and D uncertainty judgments for retired sample3.
quarantined-review-evidence.loss: The reviewed pixel and native-candidate context cannot be recreated by an authorized new sample3 decode.
quarantined-review-evidence.minimality: Eight bound source/context files; complete causal rows/scripts remain in the tracked 10 MB gzip.
quarantined-review-evidence.review_when: When an equally expressive canonical record replaces this specific review evidence; no sample3 replay.

qualified-source-geometry.use: Preserve current P0 base/sample2/3/4 weak-boundary, blur and reframing context, including reader uncertainty.
qualified-source-geometry.loss: Exact inspected source/annotation geometry and old capture/reader context.
qualified-source-geometry.minimality: 23 images plus capture/preflight/reader record from the completed audit; no failed first-attempt capture or audit source checkout.
qualified-source-geometry.review_when: When the roster input contract supersedes these particular inspected views.

current-peer-baseline.use: Continue checking the current wrong-owner peer attribution against saved raw and completed results.
current-peer-baseline.loss: Complete per-candidate comparison baseline would require a detector replay; a score summary alone cannot verify joins.
current-peer-baseline.minimality: Only raw/completed/summary, 26.4 MB; retire equivalent FULL raw/completed and trace.
current-peer-baseline.review_when: When a verified successor baseline replaces this candidate attribution.

current-report-review.use: Retain one actual baseline report for the still-open independent comprehension review of extrema/motion/Foam stories.
current-report-review.loss: The actual reviewer-facing rendering, graph and source sequence context.
current-report-review.minimality: One HTML bundle and its assets, 42 files; no other old report set, debug trace or log.
current-report-review.review_when: When the independent report review is resolved or a newer baseline report supersedes it.

retirement_review.decision_use: Closed or superseded runs have no current need for complete per-run byte replay. Current comparison/source-review assets are explicitly retained above.
retirement_review.loss_if_removed: Full historical runners that depended on retired paths, per-pixel temporal stacks, expanded source snapshots, old report rendering and native Local XY full-corpus arithmetic are no longer available as complete byte-replay bundles. Hashes are provenance, not a backup.
retirement_review.reproduction: Original eight videos, Git source history, frozen tracked runners/readouts/conditions and reviewed truth remain. Reproduction may require an old environment and is not promised byte-identical. sample3/private Windows replay is not authorized; their surviving canonical observations remain the evidence.
retirement_review.minimality: Dispose derived frames/arrays/traces, source copies, redundant handoffs and past passing-test detail. Keep tracked complete comparison readouts/denominators and selected judgment-bearing source/counterexample assets. No replacement bulk archive.
retirement_review.review_when: Future work must use the retained roster or explicitly plan new evidence; an old link/verifier does not reopen a closed hypothesis or require restoring obsolete storage.

retired_test_example.loss: Individual passing test names/timings; not an unresolved failure record.

selected_counterexample.value: Exact affine-invariance failure arrays; original runner/failure and optical-warp result already in the tracked temporal record.
